proposition: The Mafāḥiṣ was completed in 823/1420, the two earliest manuscripts giving 1 Shaʿbān 823 (11 August 1420) and 19 Dhū l-Ḥijja 823 (25 December 1420).

mediation.who: manuscript colophon / copying note as reported by Melvin-Koushki
mediation.note: two colophon dates disagree by four months
